rows.grounds: compound: lalāṭa (forehead) + varṇa (letter/syllable) + rāśi (mass/heap) + stha (situated); qualifies lakṣaṃ
numerical measure of repetitions to be performed
gerund indicating completion of the prescribed repetition
compound vocative addressing the practitioner: sura (god) + arcita (worshipped)

items.question: What forehead-centered repetition must the god-worshipped practitioner complete as part of this secret practice?
premises: The prescribed act is a repetition numbering one hundred thousand.
This repetition is situated in the mass of letters at the forehead.
The instruction is addressed to a practitioner honored as worshipped by gods.
items.inference: The secret practice requires the god-worshipped practitioner to complete a hundred-thousandfold repetition focused in the forehead's letter-mass.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the varṇa-rāśi at the forehead is not specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: O one worshipped by the gods, having performed a hundred thousand repetitions situated in the mass of letters at the forehead.
